placeholders.note: UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER: all values in this dict. No datasheet in the repo; round numbers for FDM PA-CF / TPU 95A / hardened steel dowel.

M_source: cad/plate_pocket.py: 24.8 N m (AK70 peak, S1/S2) limit moment about each axis
lever_source: stl/shoulder/pauldron/pauldron.json 'splices' (frame 'at'); lever = |at| from P = origin; P is the S1/S2/S3 intersection

M4_halflap.note: shank-in-shear would give 1.4x lower stress; thread stress area used. Preload friction not counted. Section modulus at the seam: two 4.5 mm halves = 121.5 mm3 (non-composite) .. 243.0 (composite)

A_dual_pin.one_pin_loose_joint_still_held_in_t_and_: yes: dovetail flanks lock t and w, the remaining pin still blocks z' and the w-slide
A_dual_pin.note: pins sit 9 mm apart (M4 bolts 12 mm): the moment couple on the pins is 1.33x the bolt couple; the tongue neck (8 x 9) is 44 % of the strut section modulus (243 mm3)

strut_bending_reference.note: if the wrap-arm really carried V at the pad, the unspliced 18 x 9 strut itself would be over the placeholder strength: the bound case is not a design load, it shows that the splice is not the weak link in that case

A_vs_M4_fe_bearing.note: In-plane bearing / tear-out slice with the force toward the nearest free edge (worst in-plane direction). The real pin loads act mostly out of this plane (z'); the slice is a check on edge distance and hole stress concentration, not a full 3D model. FE stress uses plane strain Lame constants (skfem linear_elasticity default) - conservative by ~10 %. Peak is sampled 1.2-2 r from the hole (point-load singularity excluded), so it is a lower bound of the hole-edge value.

axial_pullout.shear_across_layers_alt: lug rooted horizontally: load goes through the layer adhesion; if printed with the stem axis in the bed plane (on its side) the lug bending is in-plane and the limit rises to ~396 N (XY strength)

play.note: channel is lug + 2 clr: 0.5 mm axial rattle at 0.25; a 0.5 mm TPU wave washer / O-ring under the base is needed to preload the lugs against the channel roof (not modelled)

B.chamfer_note: the ramp angles assume 30/45 deg chamfers on the lug edges and a dome nose; the coupon CAD has square lug edges (add in detail design)

C.note: stress = E' t theta / (2 L), uniform-curvature S-bend of a clamped-clamped leaf whose end block rotates by theta (E' = E/(1-nu^2)). Axial stretch of the leaves (second order) and the crossing offset are ignored.

PACF.cycles: static failure at first stroke (stress >= placeholder UTS)

TPU.cycles: UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER: strain 2.2 % vs 5 % working strain assumed for >1e6 cycles in 95A TPU

C.pinned_reference: d3 steel pin in d3.1 running hole (claw_hand.py): no fatigue limit in this range, 0.1 mm radial play, survives the full stroke
